    The regular representation of a linearization #

    For a finite ray category P, the space k^(P*) with basis the nonzero morphisms carries a right action of P: a morphism g sends μ to μ ≫ g when this composite is defined and nonzero, and to zero otherwise (RayQuiver.morAct). Composition of actions is composition of morphisms (morAct_comp). This gives a representation of the path algebra of Q_P, used to show that the nonzero morphisms form a basis of k(P).
